description: This source file implements a SHA1 file hashing infrastructure used within Git for verifying file integrity, including functions for writing, flushing, finalizing, discarding, and validating hash files. It handles buffer management, checksum calculations, and file I/O operations related to hash verification.

methods.name: void verify_buffer_or_die(struct hashfile * f,const void * buf,unsigned int count)
methods.description: Verifies the check buffer against the provided buffer, ensuring data integrity, or terminates on failure.

methods.name: void flush(struct hashfile * f,const void * buf,unsigned int count)
methods.description: Writes buffered data to disk, optionally verifying buffer contents beforehand.

methods.name: void hashflush(struct hashfile * f)
methods.description: Flushes the current hash data by updating the hash state and writing data.

methods.name: void free_hashfile(struct hashfile * f)
methods.description: Frees the memory allocated for a hashfile object.

methods.name: int finalize_hashfile(struct hashfile * f,unsigned char * result,enum fsync_component component,unsigned int flags)
methods.description: Finalizes the hash calculation, writes the final hash results, performs cleanup, and optionally syncs and closes files.

methods.name: void discard_hashfile(struct hashfile * f)
methods.description: Closes any open file descriptors and frees the hashfile object, effectively discarding ongoing hashing operations.

methods.name: void hashwrite(struct hashfile * f,const void * buf,unsigned int count)
methods.description: Writes data to the hashfile, updating the buffer and hash state appropriately.

methods.name: struct:hashfile * hashfd_check(const struct git_hash_algo * algop,const char * name)
methods.description: Creates a hashfile associated with a file descriptor, with a check against a given file.

methods.name: struct:hashfile * hashfd_internal(const struct git_hash_algo * algop,int fd,const char * name,struct progress * tp,size_t buffer_len)
methods.description: Internal function to create and initialize a hashfile handle with custom buffer size and progress reporting.

methods.name: struct:hashfile * hashfd(const struct git_hash_algo * algop,int fd,const char * name)
methods.description: Creates a hashfile for a given file descriptor with default buffer size for bulk data transfer.

methods.name: struct:hashfile * hashfd_throughput(const struct git_hash_algo * algop,int fd,const char * name,struct progress * tp)
methods.description: Creates a hashfile with smaller buffer size optimized for throughput reporting.

methods.name: void hashfile_checkpoint_init(struct hashfile * f,struct hashfile_checkpoint * checkpoint)
methods.description: Initializes a checkpoint for a hashfile, resetting hash context.

methods.name: void hashfile_checkpoint(struct hashfile * f,struct hashfile_checkpoint * checkpoint)
methods.description: Stores the current position and hash context into a checkpoint.

methods.name: int hashfile_truncate(struct hashfile * f,struct hashfile_checkpoint * checkpoint)
methods.description: Truncates the hashfile to a checkpoint position, adjusting internal state accordingly.

methods.name: uint32_t crc32_end(struct hashfile * f)
methods.description: Completes CRC32 checksum calculation and returns the value.

methods.name: int hashfile_checksum_valid(const struct git_hash_algo * algop,const unsigned char * data,size_t total_len)
methods.description: Validates the checksum of data against the expected hash to ensure integrity.
